guide.foliostest.field_journal.name: Field Journal
guide.foliostest.field_journal.subtitle: A demo of the handheld style
guide.foliostest.field_journal.summary: Notes on the land, gathered on the road.
guide.foliostest.field_journal.landing:
Welcome to the **Folios** demo. This book shows every kind of page a guide can have.

Pick a category to begin, or [jump straight to the basics](entry:basics/first_steps).

> Books are plain JSON in a resource pack: press **F3 + T** to reload them while you write.
Where everyone starts. Text, links and the small Markdown books are written in.
Recipes drawn as the game shows them, asked of the server when needed.
Opens once you have mined some stone.
Creatures and builds, turning in windows of their own.
guide.foliostest.field_journal.entry.bas: Quests follow what you do: these tick themselves off as you play.

A page of text can be as long as it likes: when it does not fit, it **runs on** over the next pages by itself.

## Lists
- Punch a tree
- Make a *crafting table*
  - nested points work too
- Find some ~~diamonds~~ coal

1. Numbered
2. Lists
3. Count themselves

---
Press {key:key.inventory} to open your inventory.

# A longer read
This text is long on purpose, so you can see how a page continues onto the next one without anyone having to split it by hand. Books where each page is cut to size by its writer are a chore; here the layout does it for you, in any language and at any font.

Links go anywhere in the book: to [a recipe page](crafting/tools#pickaxe), to a [whole category](category:world), or out to [the docs](https://ixdarklord.github.io/CoolCatLib/).

> Notes like this one are set apart with a bar in the book's colour.

Colours are written like {#E06A3A}this{/}, and `code` looks like this. The rest of this paragraph is here to fill the page so that it spills over: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog, again and again, until the page is full and the words keep going on the next page.

Every text can be a **translation key**, so a book can live in lang files.

- `**bold**` gives **bold**
- `*italic*` gives *italic*
- `__under__` gives __under__
- `~~struck~~` gives ~~struck~~
- `[label](target)` makes a link
A **spotlight** shows an item large. The book remembers it: press this item anywhere else in the book to come back here.
Image pages keep a picture's proportions; several are shown in turn with arrows.
guide.foliostest.field_journal.entry.cra: Item tags are shown in turn: every pickaxe there is.
Two recipes fit on a page.
Smelting shows its fuel and how long it takes.
guide.foliostest.field_journal.entry.sec: This category opened when you mined stone.
Secret entries stay hidden until they open. This one needs a flag the test mod sets.
guide.foliostest.field_journal.entry.wor: What a build takes is listed under it.
Sheep, turning slowly. Drawn to a texture of its own, so it works on a screen and on a book in your hands alike.
You found diamonds, so this entry opened.
Some pages are too wide for one page. A **spread** lies over both pages of the open book: a map of where to go next, a build to walk round, a wide picture.
Drag it round; the eye builds it in the world.
